overview: This short Senate resolution recognizes September 15, 2026, as National Voter Registration Day. It encourages every citizen who is eligible to vote to register, to check with their state or local election office that their name, address, and other details on file are current, and to vote on Election Day if they choose to. It does not change any voting rules or spending. As of September 16, 2026, the Senate had agreed to it.
for: Supporters say reminding people to register and to check their records ahead of an election helps avoid problems at the polls.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
